name: Release Package

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*.*'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Release Version'
        required: true
        type: string
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0' # Weekly on Sunday at midnight

jobs:
  validate-version:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Validate version
        run: |
          EGE_VERSION=$(grep -oP '^\#define\s+EGE_VERSION\s+"v\K\d+\.\d+(\.\d+)?(-[a-zA-Z0-9_]+)?$' include/ege.h)
          if [[ "$GITHUB_REF" == "refs/tags/v*" ]]; then
            TAG_VERSION=$(echo "${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}" | sed 's/-//')
            if ! [[ $TAG_VERSION =~ ^$EGE_VERSION$ ]]; then
              echo "Error: Tag version does not match EGE_VERSION"
              exit 1
            fi
          fi
          git merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD origin/master || { echo "Error: Tag does not exist on master"; exit 1; }

  build-and-package:
    needs: validate-version
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [windows-latest, macos-latest, ubuntu-latest]
        compiler: [msvc, mingw, cross]
        architecture: [x86, x64]
        configuration: [Debug, Release]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up MSVC
        if: matrix.compiler == 'msvc'
        uses: microsoft/setup-msbuild@v1
        with:
          vs-version: '2022'
      - name: Set up MinGW
        if: matrix.compiler == 'mingw'
        uses: ilammy/msys2-action@v2
        with:
          msys2-version: 'latest'
          install: ['gcc', 'make']
      - name: Set up Cross-Compile
        if: matrix.compiler == 'cross'
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libssl-dev zlib1g-dev
      - name: Build project
        run: |
          mkdir build && cd build
          cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${{ matrix.configuration }} -DARCHITECTURE=${{ matrix.architecture }}
          make -j$(nproc)
      - name: Package artifacts
        run: |
          mkdir -p lib/${{ matrix.compiler }}/${{ matrix.architecture }}/${{ matrix.configuration }}
          cp -r bin/* lib/${{ matrix.compiler }}/${{ matrix.architecture }}/${{ matrix.configuration }}/xege*
          tar -czvf xege-${{ matrix.compiler }}-${{ matrix.architecture }}-${{ matrix.configuration }}.tar.gz lib/${{ matrix.compiler }}/${{ matrix.architecture }}/${{ matrix.configuration }}

  create-release:
    needs: build-and-package
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref_type == 'tags'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Create release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref }}
          release_name: ${{ github.ref }}
          body: |
            ## Changelog
            <!-- Add changelog here -->
          draft: true
          prerelease: false
